description: This file defines the internal interface ISiloControl for managing and controlling silos within an Orleans cluster. It includes methods for performance metrics, garbage collection, activation management, and control commands.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to check connectivity.

methods.name: ForceGarbageCollection
methods.description: Triggers garbage collection on the silo.

methods.name: ForceActivationCollection
methods.description: Forces activation collection based on the specified age limit.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves detailed statistics for grains, optionally filtered by types.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainReport
methods.description: Provides a detailed report for a specific grain.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of activations.

methods.name: MigrateRandomActivations
methods.description: Migrates a number of random activations to a target silo.

methods.name: SendControlCommandToProvider
methods.description: Sends a control command to a specified provider.

methods.name: GetActiveGrains
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active grains of a specific type.
